description: Source code for the HashingTF class in Apache Spark's MLlib, implementing feature hashing for text processing.

classes.name: HashingTF
classes.description: Implements feature hashing for text data, mapping terms to indices using hash functions, with options for binary vectors and hash algorithms.

methods.name: setBinary
methods.description: Sets whether the term frequency vector should be binary.

methods.name: setHashAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the hash algorithm used for mapping terms to indices.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given term after hashing.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the hash function based on current algorithm setting.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a document (Iterable) into a sparse term frequency vector.

methods.name: transformImpl
methods.description: Internal method to compute term frequencies from a document.

methods.name: transform (JavaIterable)
methods.description: Transforms a Java Iterable document into a vector.

methods.name: transform (RDD)
methods.description: Transforms an RDD of documents into an RDD of vectors.

methods.name: transform (JavaRDD)
methods.description: Transforms a Java RDD of documents into Java RDD of vectors.
